name: Kannada Handwritten Document Dataset
description: A benchmark dataset of Kannada handwritten documents intended to evaluate segmentation and related document analysis tasks on regional script handwriting.
reputation: A niche but well-cited dataset within regional-script document analysis and OCR research for Kannada handwriting segmentation tasks.
notes: Small, script-specific dataset from 2011 focused on segmentation and document analysis (non-LLM). Potential class/style imbalance and limited scale may limit generalization; not saturated.
